description: December municipal councillors’ sit-in count is unknown; search-only prior city-hall wage claims may be related but do not establish same organizers/episode or October event count.
ANADEC action spans multiple sites, but no simultaneous attendance count is reported by location; article geographic wording is imprecise and independent confirmation was not found.

Opinion Info confirms only that pro- and anti-change meetings were scheduled for 14 Dec. FNTV’s headline alleges a large pro-change crowd but body was unavailable; Ecomine follow-up body returned HTTP 403. Actual execution, exact site, policy demand in body, count, and any matching opposition meeting remain unresolved.
SYNAMED announced a work stoppage (no gathering evidence found); a Goma march was prohibited before its scheduled date. Neither is counted as an executed public gathering.
